personalLabel.title: Personal project display name
personalLabel.help: Change the name shown in the console. The original project name, ID, permissions, quotas and resources stay unchanged.
personalLabel.name: Display name
personalLabel.nameHelp: Use 1–64 characters. Surrounding spaces are removed; control characters are not allowed.
personalLabel.loadFailed: Could not verify the project display name or your editing permission. Reload to try again.
personalLabel.saveFailed: Could not confirm the saved name. Reload the current name before saving again.
personalLabel.readOnly: Only the verified owner of a Personal project can edit its display name.
loginPreference.title: Login workspace
loginPreference.help: By default, every human login opens your verified personal project. Opt in to reconnect to your last workspace. Revoked, deleted or disabled access falls back to personal; directory outages remain errors. This preference belongs to your exact account and identity home.
loginPreference.remember: Reconnect to my last authorized domain and project
loginPreference.failed: Could not confirm the preference. Reload before saving again.

profile.image.help: Default Gravatar sends your current email hash to Gravatar. Generated and uploaded images make no external requests. Still PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF; up to 2 MiB, 4096px and 4 million pixels. Saved as a 128px square.
profile.image.saveFailed: Could not save the image. Check your permissions or image format and try again.
profile.image.invalid: Choose a PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF file up to 2 MiB.
profile.image.loadFailed: Could not load the profile image.
password.minimum: The new password must be at least 8 characters
password.changed: Password changed. Please sign in again.
password.title: Change password
password.changeOutcomeUnknown: The password change result is unknown. Sign in again to check.
password.unavailable: Password management is unavailable for this account. Ask your administrator to check account policy, email delivery and the Keystone extension.
password.createWarning: Creating a local password allows sign-in without your identity provider’s MFA or account-disable policy. Continue only if you understand this security difference.
password.createHelp: We will send an expiring, one-use confirmation link to your account email. Open it and sign in as the same account to set a password. An existing password is never overwritten.
password.createSent: Password creation confirmation email sent. Open the link in your inbox. No password has been created yet.
password.createRequestFailed: The confirmation email could not be sent. Ask your administrator to check account policy and email delivery.
password.createOutcomeUnknown: The password creation result is unknown. It will not be retried automatically. Sign in again and ask your administrator to reconcile the result and unlock creation.
password.created: Password created. Please sign in again.
password.createSignIn: Sign in again with your provider
password.createSignInHelp: Use your identity provider (SSO) to sign in as the same account that requested this link. Sign in in this tab to return to the confirmation link.
password.createResumeFailed: This tab cannot safely retain the confirmation link. After signing in, reopen the original email link in this tab.
password.createWrongUser: The current session does not match the account that requested this link, or has expired. Sign in as the same account and reopen the email link.
password.createExisting: A password already exists; nothing was created. Sign in with your existing password or contact your administrator.
password.createFailed: The password could not be created. Do not resubmit this link; contact your administrator.
password.createIdentityChanged: The account changed, so no password was created. This link has been consumed. Request a new confirmation email from account settings.
password.createInvalidPassword: Keystone rejected the password under its length or security policy; no password was created. This link has been consumed. Request a new confirmation email from account settings, then choose a shorter password or one that meets your administrator’s policy.
password.createSessionsFailed: The password was created, but other sessions could not be revoked and may still be active. Sign in again and ask your administrator to revoke the remaining sessions. Password creation will not be retried.
password.createRateLimited: Too many confirmation email requests. Wait a while before requesting another link.

mcp.title: External AI access
mcp.scopeHelp: Personal tokens and OAuth connections issued or approved by this account are listed across all domains. Switching projects or domains does not filter this list or expand saved access and project restrictions.
mcp.workspaceRequired: View and remove existing connections without selecting a project. Select a working project to issue a key, preview permissions or verify a connection. Projects for a new approval must belong to one domain.
mcp.onceHelp: Copy the token to a secure secret store immediately after creating it. Afterward you can view its prefix, status and saved restrictions, but never the secret again.
mcp.name: Name
mcp.permissionHelp: Read is query-only. Manage also allows permitted changes. Keep client tool approval enabled.
mcp.managePreviewPending: Checking project write authority. Manage key creation is unavailable until this check finishes; read-only creation remains available.
mcp.managePreviewUnknown: Write authority could not be verified for a project. Choose read only, or refresh to check again before creating a manage key.
mcp.managePreviewReader: Your selection includes a read-only project. Choose read only, or deselect the read-only projects before creating a manage key.
mcp.projectsHelp: Select one or more projects within the current working domain. All projects saves the accessible set in that domain at issuance; new projects are not added later.
mcp.projectsRetryHelp: Refresh to load a new project list before creating a token. Previous selections cannot be used after a failed reload.
mcp.noProjects: No accessible projects. Token creation is unavailable.
mcp.savedAllProjects: All accessible projects at issuance (fixed set)
mcp.expiryHelp: Days and weeks are elapsed UTC days. Months and years use the UTC calendar, preserving the time and clamping the day to the target month's last day when needed. Custom dates use your local time zone.
mcp.invalidExpiry: Enter a valid future expiration time.
mcp.newTokenHelp: The personal key and JSON containing the real Bearer credential are shown only once. Closing the dialog or changing your sign-in or project clears them from the screen. Securely store or delete clipboard and file copies yourself.
mcp.revokeConfirm: Remove the connection for MCP key “{name}”? This revokes access for all clients sharing this key and immediately removes its connected Lumen access.
mcp.revokeOAuthConfirm: Remove OAuth connection “{name}”? This revokes access for all clients sharing this credential.
mcp.observationCount: {count, plural, one {# observed client signature} other {# observed client signatures}} · Details
mcp.observationHelp: Up to 10 signatures observed under this credential. Identity is inferred from client-reported information and request headers, not a device or session count, verified physical identity, or real-time online status.
mcp.noObservations: No client observations yet. This does not mean no clients have connected.
security.logoutConfirm:
Sign out everywhere?
Your current session will also end.
projectSettings.removeMemberConfirm: Remove {user}'s direct project roles? Group and inherited permissions may remain.
projectSettings.managerRequired: Project owner or admin permissions are required.
projectMemberRoles.title: Edit {user}'s roles
projectMemberRoles.directOnlyHelp: Across Lumen, Drover, Waygate and Palimpsest, reader is read-only; member and above manage project resources. Only direct roles change. Inherited and protected existing roles are preserved; global administration remains separate.
projectMemberRoles.searchPlaceholder: Search role names, IDs or descriptions
mcp.oauthSetupHelp: Add only the MCP URL to your client, then choose OAuth sign-in. Sign in to Afterglow, select a project and approve the requested permissions. Your client adds the required parameters to the OAuth authorization URL.
mcp.oauthClientSecretHelp: These settings contain no credential. Do not add an Authorization header or client secret. Keep tokens received by your client secure; revoke an approved connection under OAuth connections below.
mcp.setupHelp: Use a client that supports HTTP and per-user Authorization headers. Replace YOUR_PERSONAL_MCP_TOKEN below with your personal token. See the guide for client-specific formats and OAuth connections.
mcp.configSecretWarning: These settings contain your personal credential. Keep them in a private configuration file, never in a repository or shared connector.
mcp.verifyHelp: Enter a key issued for the current user and project. The input is cleared after the check and is not saved.
mcp.verified: MCP authentication and tool list verified
mcp.verificationLimit: Only initialization and tool listing were checked. This does not prove cloud access, mutation permissions or operation success.
mcp.verifyError.invalidRequest: The check request is invalid. Enter only the personal key.
mcp.verifyError.invalidToken: This is not a personal key usable by the current user and project. It may be wrong, expired or revoked; the public endpoint was not contacted.
mcp.verifyError.notConfigured: The public MCP endpoint is not configured. Contact your operator.
mcp.verifyError.rejected: The MCP endpoint rejected this personal key. Check the key status and endpoint configuration.
mcp.verifyError.redirect: The MCP endpoint redirected elsewhere, so the check stopped. The key was not sent to the redirect target.
mcp.verifyError.protocol: The MCP endpoint did not return a valid MCP response.
mcp.verifyError.unavailable: Couldn't reach the MCP endpoint, or it timed out. Check DNS, TLS and the network.
mcp.verifyError.rateLimited: Too many connection checks. Try again in a minute.
password.stateUnknown: The native password state could not be confirmed. If you know your current password, you can still change it below. First-time setup requires your administrator to make native state verification available.
password.recoveryHelp: The link sent to your registered email opens a form to choose a new password; it never sends the password itself. If no email arrives or you cannot access the mailbox, contact your administrator.
password.recoveryAccepted: Request accepted. If this account is eligible, a link will be sent to its registered email. Acceptance does not confirm delivery. Check your inbox or contact your administrator.
password.recoveryFailed: The recovery-link request could not be confirmed. It will not be retried automatically. Contact your administrator.
password.recoveryRateLimited: Too many recovery requests. Wait before requesting again.
